title: Hymn to Dusk

outfit_card.silhouette: Asymmetrical Grecian warrior silhouette featuring a draped chiton bodice, single sculpted pauldron, sweeping sunset-gradient half-cape, and a high-slit, tiered floor-length skirt.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Ornate gilded brow circlet set with multi-colored cabochons and hanging bead fringes, paired with dangling filigree chandelier earrings.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Crisscrossed ivory silk bodice over a deep bronze underlayer, accented with a golden right pauldron, jeweled choker, a ballooning puffed sleeve, and stacked geometric metal bangles.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Multi-layered high-slit skirt blending ivory pleated silk with chocolate-brown diamond-quilted panels, fastened by an ornate sun-wheel girdle, revealing strappy bronze leather gladiator sandals.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A grand two-handed bronze ceremonial broadsword with filigree guard, accompanied by ancient celestial sun motifs and radiant ember particles.
